approved_payload.content: Mfuleni police responded to a shooting in Reindeer Street, Wesbank, at about 20:10 on Saturday 10 October: Lincoln Jonathan, 14, a Grade 8 learner at Silversands High School, died at the scene and a Grade 11 learner was wounded (TygerBurger, 12 Oct, quoting police spokesperson Wesley Twigg).

checked.basis: Two reports from one outlet; the date comes from the police statement in the first.
disagreements: TygerBurger's 13 Oct follow-up says Saturday 17 October, which is after it was published; its 12 Oct report quotes police giving Saturday 10 October.
checked.incident: Sat 10 Oct 2026, about 20:10 (police, TygerBurger 12 Oct). TygerBurger's follow-up of 13 Oct wrongly says 17 October.
checked.location: Corner of Reindeer Street, Wesbank (exact spot not given). OpenStreetMap has it as Reindeer Crescent; the pin is on it.
checked.method: Collected by google_news_collector --keywords; source pages read and claims, dates and place checked by hand. Two reports from the same outlet, not independent. Standalone (no case, entity or map line).
